# A Future Full of Possibilities


Watch the SMA community as they share their hopes and excitement for the future, fueled by the potential of groundbreaking treatment. These voices are a powerful reminder that the future is brighter than ever as members of the SMA community embrace the promise of progress and a life full of potential.
